decisions.reason: Fouling detection automation was launched only in 2023, likely grew out of EU-funded research, fits the firm's energy-recovery and digital-networking direction, and costs little to keep as a software module, so the option is worth holding while its market value is still uncertain.

A web tool for weir dimensioning is cheap to maintain, draws engineering planners to the firm's core flood-control products, and its prospects are still unresolved after one year, so there is no reason to give up the option.

The hardware fouling detection system adds to the automation offering in an emerging heat-recovery niche, and with too little market evidence yet to show its value cannot be realized, keeping it open is the sound option choice, though some risk exists that it is merged with Product A.
